name: approach to pathology of aub pelvic pain pathway
title: Abnormal uterine bleeding: vitals first, then history, exam and investigations; a visible lesion means a structural cause to remove and send to pathology, otherwise ultrasound in selected patients and the functional causes, with DUB a diagnosis of exclusion.

nodes.title: Is she stable? Check vitals FIRST
History: general + full gynecologic and obstetric
lines: Physical exam: general, abdominal and pelvic
Investigations: complete blood count, beta human chorionic gonadotropin, Pap if indicated

nodes.title: Remove the lesion
lines: Send the ENTIRE specimen to pathology

nodes.title: DUB is a diagnosis of EXCLUSION

edges.label: YES — e.g. a mass at the cervical os
